Terms & Conditions

Last updated: 2026

By booking, paying for, accepting delivery of, or using a Ridgeway Rentals dump trailer, the customer (“Renter”) agrees to the following Terms & Conditions.

1. RENTAL PERIOD

The standard rental fee includes up to seven (7) days from the date of delivery.

If the trailer is required for longer than seven (7) days, additional rental time is charged at $50.00 per day, subject to trailer availability.

The Renter must contact Ridgeway Rentals before the end of the rental period if additional time is required. Extensions are not guaranteed and are subject to availability.

2. INCLUDED WEIGHT & OVERWEIGHT CHARGES

The rental fee includes disposal of up to 500 kg of material.

Any disposal weight exceeding the included 500 kg allowance will be charged at: $2 per additional kilogram

The disposal facility's measured weight will be used to determine the total disposal weight where applicable.

The Renter is responsible for all overweight charges associated with materials placed in the trailer.

3. DELIVERY & TRAILER PLACEMENT

The Renter is responsible for providing a safe, firm, level, and accessible location for delivery and pickup of the trailer.

The Renter authorizes Ridgeway Rentals and its representatives to enter the property as reasonably necessary to deliver and retrieve the trailer.

Ridgeway Rentals will make reasonable efforts to place the trailer in the Renter's requested location; however, the driver has final discretion regarding placement based on safety, accessibility, ground conditions, overhead clearances, and the ability to safely retrieve the loaded trailer.

The Renter is responsible for ensuring that the requested placement area can support the weight of the trailer and its contents.

To the extent permitted by law, Ridgeway Rentals is not responsible for damage to driveways, asphalt, concrete, interlocking stone, curbs, lawns, landscaping, underground services, septic systems, irrigation systems, or other property resulting from the normal placement, loading, or removal of the trailer, except where caused by Ridgeway Rentals' negligence.

4. LOADING REQUIREMENTS

All materials must remain completely inside the trailer.
Nothing may extend above the top edge of the trailer or hang over the sides, front, or rear.

The load must be reasonably level and evenly distributed.

The Renter must not concentrate excessive weight in one area of the trailer.

The trailer doors must be able to completely close and securely latch before pickup.

Ridgeway Rentals may refuse to transport any trailer that is overloaded, improperly loaded, unsafe, or not compliant with these Terms & Conditions.

The Renter will be required to remove or redistribute material before pickup if Ridgeway Rentals determines that the trailer cannot be safely or legally transported.

5. CONCRETE, SOIL, SHINGLES & HEAVY MATERIALS

Ridgeway Rentals must be notified BEFORE any concrete, soil, dirt, roofing shingles, or similar heavy material is placed in the trailer. Failure to do so may result in additional fees or refusal of service.

Concrete, soil/dirt, and shingles must be kept separate from other waste materials and may not be mixed together or mixed with general household or construction waste unless specifically approved by Ridgeway Rentals.

Heavy materials are subject to specific loading limits due to trailer payload and legal transportation weight restrictions.

Ridgeway Rentals will advise the Renter of the allowable quantity or fill level before loading begins.

The Renter must follow all loading instructions provided by Ridgeway Rentals.
Failure to notify Ridgeway Rentals or failure to properly separate these materials may result in additional disposal charges, unloading requirements, a failed pickup charge, and/or other applicable fees.

6. PROHIBITED ITEMS & MATERIALS

The following items are STRICTLY PROHIBITED and must NOT be placed in a Ridgeway Rentals trailer:

  • Tires of any kind
  • Asbestos or asbestos-containing materials
  • Hazardous waste or hazardous materials
  • Gasoline, diesel fuel, kerosene, or other fuels
  • Propane tanks or cylinders
  • Compressed gas cylinders
  • Oxygen tanks
  • Paint, paint thinner, stains, varnishes, or solvents
  • Motor oil or other automotive fluids
  • Antifreeze
  • Pesticides and herbicides
  • Industrial or hazardous chemicals
  • Flammable materials
  • Explosive materials
  • Fireworks
  • Ammunition or explosive devices
  • Automotive, lithium, industrial, or other hazardous batteries
  • Medical or biomedical waste
  • Needles or syringes
  • Pharmaceutical waste
  • Radioactive materials
  • Contaminated soil
  • Sewage or human waste
  • Animal waste in bulk quantities
  • Biohazardous materials
  • Liquid waste of any kind
  • Hot ashes or hot coals
  • Burning or smoldering materials
  • Dead animals or animal carcasses
  • Any illegal substances or materials
  • Any material prohibited by the receiving disposal facility
  • Any material prohibited by applicable municipal, provincial, or federal laws

If you are unsure whether an item is permitted, contact Ridgeway Rentals BEFORE placing it in the trailer.

7. PROHIBITED ITEM FEE

A minimum prohibited item fee of $200.00 will apply if prohibited materials are placed in the trailer.

The $200 prohibited item fee is in addition to any actual costs incurred by Ridgeway Rentals for handling, removing, transporting, returning, cleaning, or properly disposing of the prohibited material.

If a disposal facility rejects a load because prohibited materials are present, the Renter will be responsible for applicable additional costs and fees.

The Renter is responsible for everything placed in the trailer during the rental period, including materials placed in the trailer by neighbours, contractors, members of the public, or any other third party.

8. FAILED PICKUP FEE

A $50.00 failed pickup fee may be charged when Ridgeway Rentals arrives for a scheduled pickup and is unable to safely retrieve the trailer due to circumstances within the Renter's control, including:

  • Blocked access to the trailer
  • Vehicles or equipment preventing pickup
  • Gates being locked or inaccessible
  • Trailer being overloaded
  • Materials extending above or outside the trailer
  • Improperly distributed loads
  • Trailer doors being unable to close
  • Prohibited materials being present
  • Heavy materials being loaded contrary to Ridgeway Rentals' instructions
  • Unsafe site conditions that should reasonably have been addressed by the Renter

The Renter must correct the issue before another pickup attempt is made.

9. TRAILER USE

The trailer is provided for waste and debris collection only.

The Renter must NOT:

  • Move, tow, relocate, or reposition the trailer.
  • Permit another person or company to move or tow the trailer.
  • Allow children to enter or play in or around the trailer.
  • Climb on the trailer.
  • Burn materials inside the trailer.
  • Modify, drill, weld, paint, or otherwise alter the trailer.
  • Use machinery to compact materials inside the trailer without written approval.
  • Load the trailer in a manner that could damage the trailer or create an unsafe condition.

Only Ridgeway Rentals or an authorized representative may move or tow the trailer.

10. CUSTOMER RESPONSIBILITY

The Renter is responsible for the trailer and its contents while the trailer is located at the delivery address.

The Renter should take reasonable precautions to prevent unauthorized use, vandalism, or other persons from placing prohibited materials in the trailer.

The Renter is responsible for obtaining any required permits, parking permissions, municipal approvals, condominium approvals, or property-owner authorization required for placement of the trailer.

11. DAMAGE TO THE TRAILER

The Renter may be responsible for repair or replacement costs for damage caused by misuse, overloading, improper loading, unauthorized movement, prohibited materials, fire, or other damage caused by the Renter or persons using the trailer with the Renter's permission.

Normal wear and tear is excluded.

12. ACCESS FOR PICKUP

The Renter must provide Ridgeway Rentals with clear and safe access to the trailer on the scheduled pickup date.

Vehicles, equipment, construction materials, snow, gates, or other obstructions must not prevent Ridgeway Rentals from safely retrieving the trailer.

Additional charges may apply if a return trip is required.

13. SUMMARY OF STANDARD FEES

Fee: $395.00
Standard Rental Period: Up to 7 days
If additional dump trip required within the 7 days: $250.00 additional fee
Included Disposal Weight: 500 kg
Additional Weight: $2.00/kg over 500 kg
Additional Rental Days: $50.00/day
Failed Pickup Fee: $50.00
Prohibited Item Fee: Minimum $200.00, plus any additional handling or disposal costs

Tires: NOT PERMITTED

Concrete / Soil / Dirt / Shingles: Ridgeway Rentals must be notified in advance.
These materials must be separated and loaded according to Ridgeway Rentals' instructions.

Applicable taxes will be added to fees where required.

14. WEATHER

The Renter is responsible for taking reasonable precautions to protect the trailer and its contents from weather conditions where appropriate.

Rain, snow, ice, and water accumulation can increase the weight of materials in the trailer. The Renter remains responsible for disposal weight exceeding the included 500 kg allowance.

15. RIGHT TO REFUSE TRANSPORTATION

Ridgeway Rentals reserves the right to delay or refuse pickup if the trailer is:

  • Overloaded
  • Improperly loaded
  • Unsafe to transport
  • Inaccessible
  • Loaded with prohibited materials
  • Loaded contrary to Ridgeway Rentals' instructions
  • Otherwise, unable to be legally or safely transported

16. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

To the extent permitted by applicable law, Ridgeway Rentals is not responsible for indirect or consequential losses resulting from the rental or use of the trailer including any damage to the driveway.

Nothing in these Terms & Conditions is intended to exclude or limit any rights or liabilities that cannot legally be excluded or limited under applicable Ontario law.

17. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS

By booking a trailer, making payment, signing a rental agreement, or accepting delivery of a Ridgeway Rentals trailer, the Renter confirms that they have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms & Conditions.

The Renter is responsible for ensuring that anyone who uses or places material into the trailer is aware of and complies with these Terms & Conditions.

IF YOU ARE UNSURE WHETHER SOMETHING CAN GO IN THE TRAILER, CONTACT RIDGEWAY RENTALS BEFORE DISPOSING OF IT.
